meta.name: linkedin-engager-analytics
meta.description: Pull the people who liked or commented on any LinkedIn post and segment them by ICP fit (peer / aspirational / prospect / other). Produces an engager roster, tier breakdown, and outbound action lists (follow back, comment-drop, DM-able with one-line openers). Powered by Apify, no LinkedIn login. Triggers on "who liked my post", "who engaged", "engagers report", "audience analytics". Not for tracking author replies to your comments (use linkedin-thread-monitor).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 找出点赞评论过你帖子的联系人,按匹配度分层并生成跟进清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在 LinkedIn 发帖后想知道谁互动了、哪些值得主动跟进
copy.tagline_en: Turn post likers and commenters into ranked, follow-up-ready contact lists
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you post on LinkedIn and want to know who engaged and who's worth following up

howto.what: 你给它一个或多个 LinkedIn 帖子链接,它会拉出所有点赞和评论的人,按 ICP 匹配度分成 peer / aspirational / prospect / other 四档,并产出互动者名单和跟进动作清单(回关、评论、私信开场白)。需要 APIFY_TOKEN,没有时改为让你粘贴名单。
howto.when: 当你说“who liked my post”“who engaged”等触发词,或发帖后想知道谁互动了、活动前要分析竞品帖子评论者时触发。不适用于跟踪作者对你评论的回复(那用 linkedin-thread-monitor)。

say.text: 谁点赞和评论了我这篇帖子?按 ICP 分档列出来
say.note: 会拉取互动者名单、分档并附跟进动作清单

say.text: 把这几个竞品爆款帖的评论者按公司规模分组
say.note: 支持多个帖子 URL,会去重并标出互动 2 次以上的人

say.text: 给我这篇帖子 prospect 档的私信开场白
say.note: 每个互动者一条,引用其互动过的帖子角度

howto.what_en: Given one or more LinkedIn post URLs, it pulls likers and commenters, sorts them into peer / aspirational / prospect / other ICP tiers, and returns a roster plus action lists. Without APIFY_TOKEN you paste the list.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "who liked my post", "who engaged" and similar phrases, or when checking who engaged after a post or analyzing competitor commenters. Not for tracking author replies to your comments.

say_en.text: Who liked and commented on my post? Break them down by ICP tier
say_en.note: Returns engager roster with tiers and action lists

say_en.text: Group the commenters on these competitor posts by company size
say_en.note: Accepts multiple post URLs; dedupes and flags 2+ engagements

say_en.text: Give me DM openers for the prospect tier on this post
say_en.note: One line each, citing the post the engager reacted to
